notes:
Summary: Mid-market ecommerce company building real-time product personalization and search reranking. Heavy emphasis on sub-100ms tail latency for recommendation API and strict EU data residency for order histories. Eng team: 6 ML engineers + infra. Commercial ask: dedicated pool or private (VPC) deployment with KMS integration, 12-month reserved commit.

Why lost: Pricing + product package — Together offered a hosted + transfer migration bundle that matched their short-term budget and promised lower unit cost for their predictable peak. Key technical blockers slowed us down: security team requested encryption-at-rest architecture diagram and third-party pentest evidence; our responses were timely but review lagged. Internal champion (Sr. ML Eng) accepted role change to platform team in late Jan and momentum dropped. Procurement then had a temporary hiring freeze; procurement prioritized lower initial spend and faster time-to-production.

Direct quotes / call snippets: "We love Redwood's observability, but we need a partner who can get us live in 4 weeks on a hosted plan and shave the first-year bill — the board is pushing for immediate ROI." — CTO (02/26).

Technical notes: Evaluated quantized Mistral-variant and smaller ensemble for reranking. POC traffic: 300qps peak (10k qps token-level equivalent) with 45ms median; SLO is 90ms p95. Suggested configuration: 4x A100-equivalent nodes with prefix caching and model fallback to 7B variant. Customer concerned about KV cache warm-up on Private.

Security thread: Requested SOC2 Type II evidence, SLAs for audit log retention (7 years), and proof of KMS integration (HSM-backed). Legal wanted clause for EU data residency and breach notification timeline.

Next steps / follow-up plan: Documented win/loss, share technical collateral in repo, assign for potential re-engage in Q4 2026 after hiring/budget cycle. Low-probability nurture: send product updates on Private deployment roadmap and Optimize batching improvements.

Action items still open: update security FAQ with HSM diagrams (owner: SE), finalize cost-comparison summary vs Together (owner: AE), capture detailed timeline of procurement decision for internal review.
